snippet.title: Vivarium - Official Summer Vacay Update Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Relax and build a chill virtual aquarium filled with summer vibes in the Summer Vacay update for Vivarium. Check out the Vivarium trailer to see what you can expect with this update, available on Meta and Pico on July 24, 2025.
